privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How On Site Building Construction Limited handles information shared through our website and enquiries.
intro: On Site Building Construction Limited operates onsitebuild.co.nz. This statement explains how we handle personal information when you browse our website, contact us or send information about a building project.

sections.heading: Information you provide
paragraphs: We collect the details you give us when you make an enquiry, such as your name, email address, phone number, project location, the service you are interested in and your message. This also includes any plans, photographs or other files you choose to send, and our correspondence with you.

Providing information is voluntary. If you leave out details needed to understand your project or contact you, we may be unable to respond fully or prepare a quote. Please only share information relevant to your enquiry, and obtain permission before providing someone else's personal information.

sections.heading: Why we use your information
paragraphs: We use enquiry information to respond to you, understand your requirements, discuss services, arrange a conversation or site visit, and prepare a quote when requested. If you engage us, relevant information may also be used to organise and communicate about the agreed work.

We may keep correspondence needed to maintain business records, resolve an issue or meet a legal obligation. Information will not be used for an unrelated purpose unless you authorise it or the law permits it.

sections.heading: Website operation and external content
paragraphs: The systems that host and protect the website may record technical details such as an IP address, the requested page, the time of a request and information about an error. These records help operate the site, identify faults and prevent misuse.

If you follow an external link or use content embedded from another organisation, that provider may receive technical information from your browser and use its own cookies. Its privacy information explains how it handles that data. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Who can receive your information
paragraphs: Your enquiry is available to the people who need it to respond or organise the work you request. Our website hosting and email providers process information to run the website and deliver messages on our behalf.

We may disclose information with your permission, where necessary for the purpose explained when it was collected, or where disclosure is required or permitted by law. We do not make your enquiry or uploaded files public simply because you send them to us.

sections.heading: Storage, security and retention
paragraphs: We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from loss and unauthorised access, use or disclosure. Access should be limited to people and providers who need the information for the purposes described here.

Our technology providers may process or store information outside New Zealand. We remain responsible for information handled on our behalf and take steps appropriate to the arrangement to meet our obligations under the Privacy Act 2020.

We keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for a lawful purpose, including handling an enquiry, managing agreed work or meeting record-keeping requirements. When it is no longer needed, it should be securely deleted or made anonymous.

sections.heading: Accessing or correcting your information
paragraphs: You can ask us whether we hold information about you, request access to it and ask us to correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete. Contact us using the details below. We may need to confirm your identity before providing personal information.

We respond to access requests within the time required by the Privacy Act 2020, normally 20 working days. If a lawful extension is needed, we will explain it. If we do not make a correction you request, you can ask for a statement of the requested correction to be attached to the information.

You may also ask us to remove information we no longer need. Some records may need to be retained for legal obligations or ongoing work; there is no automatic promise that every record can be deleted on request.

sections.heading: Questions or privacy concerns
paragraphs: Contact On Site Building Construction Limited at onsitebuilding1@gmail.com or call 021 715 196 if you have a question, an access or correction request, or a concern about your information.
Please give us an opportunity to address a privacy concern. If it remains unresolved, you can contact the New Zealand Office of the Privacy Commissioner.

sections.heading: Updates to this statement
paragraphs: We may update this page when the website or the way we handle information changes. The date above identifies the current version. If a change affects how information is collected or used, we will provide any additional notice required by law.

terms.title: Website Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for using the On Site Building website and making an enquiry.
intro: These terms apply to your use of onsitebuild.co.nz, operated by On Site Building Construction Limited. They explain how you may use this website and its content.

sections.heading: Website information
paragraphs: The website introduces our services and showcases projects. It provides general information rather than a specification, estimate or professional assessment of your particular property. Contact us to discuss the requirements, suitability and availability of services for your project.

We aim to keep the website accurate and useful. If you notice an error or need to confirm a detail, please get in touch. Project photographs and descriptions should be read in their stated context and do not promise an identical result for another property.

sections.heading: Enquiries, quotes and building work
paragraphs: Sending an enquiry does not by itself confirm a booking or create a building contract. Any work is subject to the scope and terms agreed with you.

These website terms do not set prices, deposits, payment schedules, cancellation charges or construction warranties, and do not change an existing quote or contract. Those matters belong in the agreement for your particular project, subject to applicable law.

sections.heading: Information and files you send
paragraphs: Please provide accurate contact and project details and only send material you have permission to share. Do not upload malicious files, unlawful material or personal information unrelated to your enquiry.

Sending plans, photographs or other files allows us to review them and use them to respond to your request. It does not transfer ownership to us or give us permission to publish them as marketing material.

sections.heading: Using website content
paragraphs: The website's text, photographs, branding and design belong to their respective rights holders. You may view the site and keep a copy of relevant information for your own consideration of our services.

Please obtain permission before reusing website material in your own advertising, publishing it elsewhere or selling it. This does not restrict any use allowed by law. Links to our website must not falsely suggest an endorsement or misrepresent our business.

sections.heading: Responsible use and availability
paragraphs: Use the website lawfully. Do not interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorised access, introduce malicious code or use enquiry channels for spam.
The site may occasionally be unavailable or a feature may not work as expected. If an enquiry does not go through, contact us directly by email or phone.

sections.heading: External websites and privacy
paragraphs: Links and embedded content may take you to services operated by other organisations. Their own terms and privacy statements apply to your use of those services. A link does not necessarily mean we endorse all of the provider's content.
Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle information collected through this website and your enquiries.

sections.heading: Your rights under New Zealand law
paragraphs: Nothing in these terms excludes or restricts a right or remedy under the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993, the Fair Trading Act 1986 or other New Zealand law where that right or remedy cannot lawfully be excluded or restricted.

These terms do not remove our obligations under an agreed building contract. New Zealand law applies to use of this website, without limiting any right you have to seek help from a court, tribunal or relevant authority.

sections.heading: Updates and contact
paragraphs: We may update these website terms by publishing a revised version with a new date. Changes apply to future use of the website and do not retrospectively change a project agreement.
For questions about the website or these terms, contact On Site Building Construction Limited at onsitebuilding1@gmail.com or call 021 715 196.
